title: DIG Step-Pack Manifest
description: Manifest for a step pack — a distributable bundle of step (and optionally connector) plugins. Lives at the root of the pack archive as `pack.json`. The runtime validates this file before any code is loaded.

id.description: Stable, unique pack identifier. snake_case. Must match the pack's top-level directory name inside the .dpack archive.

version.description: Semantic version of the pack. The .dpack filename should embed this version (e.g. `statspack-1.0.0.dpack`).

label.description: Human-readable display name shown in the Step-Packs UI. House style: emoji prefix.

description.description: One-paragraph description of what the pack adds. Surfaced in the install dialog.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. AGPL-3.0, MIT, Apache-2.0).

homepage.description: Optional URL to the pack's homepage / source / docs.

minDigVersion.description: Minimum DIG host version this pack expects. Loader rejects packs whose minDigVersion is greater than the running backend's version.

steps.description: Declared list of step IDs the pack ships. Must match the directories under `steps/` in the archive.

connectors.description: Declared list of connector IDs the pack ships. Must match the directories under `connectors/` in the archive.

items.description: PEP 508 requirement string — name[extras][specifier][;marker]. URL/VCS/path forms (`git+`, `pkg @ url`, `./local`, `-e`) and pip flags (anything starting with `-`) are rejected to prevent supply-chain redirection.

pythonRequirements.description: Pip-style requirements (e.g. `scipy>=1.11`). When auto-install is enabled (DIG_PACK_AUTO_INSTALL_DEPS), each entry is validated against the strict subset above and installed via `pip install --isolated --index-url https://pypi.org/simple/ -- <reqs>`. Operators can override the index with DIG_PIP_INDEX_URL.

checksum.description: sha256 of the archive contents, stamped at build time by build_pack.py. Used by the install registry for integrity verification.

signature.description: Optional ed25519 signature of `checksum` by the pack publisher. Reserved for v2; current builds may omit.

metadata.description: Free-form pack/author metadata not interpreted by DIG core.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension fields. Vendors / enterprise / forks attach their own data under a top-level namespace key (e.g. extensions.acme.distributionChannel) so future first-party fields never collide.
